bio: Sitting within a residential district, but in walking distance from the city centre, this cosy bistro is tied together with a nod to nature and the vast forests of Podlaskie. The dining room is decorated in earthy shades from brown to terracotta, while branches and wood elements complete the effect. Flatbreads are a feature on the sensibly priced menu, which also includes the likes of saffron milk-cap mushrooms with an intense consommé or tender, subtly gamey roe deer – the overarching principle is quality ingredients treated with the care they deserve.
